title: Fundamentals in Health Economics
description: How economists analyse health and health care: why these markets are special, where they fail, how people demand care and insurance, and how governments and health systems respond.
assessment: Closed-book written exam, 90 minutes. Grades on the 18–30 scale. More details are given in class.
textbooks: Bhattacharya, J., Hyde, T. & Tu, P. (2014). Health Economics. Palgrave Macmillan.
Sloan, F. A. & Hsieh, C.-R. (2012). Health Economics. MIT Press.
Folland, S., Goodman, A. C. & Stano, M. (2007). The Economics of Health and Health Care. Prentice Hall.
